termination_cause: physical invocation boundary; continuing frontier remains nonempty and this is not global completion
material_delta: Strong matched frozen-bank held-out reuse evidence now exists: ContraMem separates no-memory, self-memory, and shared frozen memory under the same target-task setting, but exact single-update causal reuse remains unresolved.
ProgRouter shows evolving-state progress can support budgeted routing, while naive progress/cost greedy control can catastrophically fail; progress prediction must not be equated with control value.
Self-improving memory evaluations are highly task-order and run-variance sensitive; chronological improvement curves require randomized or blocked order and repeated runs.
Frozen holdout and live-profile/runtime evaluation can rank configurations very differently, so these evaluation surfaces should remain separate.
No matched randomized software-agent reviewer/critic-routing study was found; this remains an explicit frontier.
exact_next_action: Search for per-update matched frozen-state replay in software/tool agents where the same future task, full bank, runtime, model and budget are fixed and exactly one admitted memory/skill/verifier/routing update is toggled ON/OFF; in parallel search for randomized or propensity-logged reviewer/critic routing and action-conditioned progress-to-intervention-value studies.
